problem_statement: Draining the renewal queue aborts with `KeyError: 'stale_prescription'` raised from `AuditNotifier.deliver` as soon as it reaches a renewal whose last fill is older than 180 days. Every request queued after the stale one is left unprocessed until someone restarts the drain. Stale renewals are supposed to be held for pharmacist review and the drain should carry on with the rest of the queue. `tests/test_pipeline.py::test_stale_renewal_is_held_for_review` and `test_drain_continues_after_stale_renewal` reproduce it. Please fix it so the suite passes.
